title: oxalis alba
intro: Oxalis alba, commonly known as White Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Oxalidaceae family. This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support kidney function and reduce inflammation, due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis alba are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include oxalic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, that may possess antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of Oxalis alba on human health.
